cli.description: gitswitch - Manage Git identities, SSH keys, and active provider profiles from the command line
cli.afterHelp:
Examples:
  gitswitch list
  gitswitch current
  gitswitch switch octocat
  gitswitch add --provider github --key ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

Providers can be referenced by built-in id or display name, such as github, gitlab, or bitbucket.

args.name: hidden
args.description: Start the desktop app hidden in the system tray

list.afterHelp:
Prints every saved GitSwitch profile. The active profile is marked with an asterisk.

Example:
  gitswitch list

switch.description: Switch to a saved profile by login
switch.afterHelp:
Activates a saved profile by its login name. This updates GitSwitch state and applies the selected identity for Git operations.

Example:
  gitswitch switch octocat

args.name: login
args.description: Login or username of the saved profile to activate

current.afterHelp:
Prints the profile currently selected in GitSwitch. If no profile is active, the command reports that state.

Example:
  gitswitch current

add.description: Add a profile from an SSH private key
add.afterHelp:
Resolves an SSH private key against the selected provider, discovers the matching account, and saves it as a GitSwitch profile.

Example:
  gitswitch add --provider github --key ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

args.name: provider
args.description: Provider id or name, for example github, gitlab, or bitbucket

args.name: key
args.description: Path to the SSH private key used to identify the account
